# Name Part Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NamePartType`](gmeow-NamePartType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NamePartType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)

The kind of a name part (given, surname, patronymic, particle, Arabic nisba, filename extension, …). A value, not a [`NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md) subclass: naming systems worldwide contribute an open-ended set of part kinds that share [`NamePart`](gmeow-NamePart.md)'s structure.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NamePartType`](gmeow-NamePartType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
